messages:
Maya: Kicking off percent rollout rr-20260320-47 for inference-micro v2.3 now (16:00 UTC). Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~45m. Initial target = 10% across regions.
deploy-bot: Rollout rr-20260320-47 started. target model: inference-micro-v2.3, initial_pct: 10%
Chris: noted — i'll watch latency dashboards and traces. alerts active.
Jordan: i'm on pager until 17:30, can jump if anything spikes.
Maya: Quick gating thresholds for this run: if p95 > 500ms in any region OR error_rate_delta > +0.5% from baseline -> hold and escalate. Also, if any KV cache OOMs or host evictions, pause.
Priya: small kvcache evictions showing on two canaries, not user-visible yet. digging.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 10% across prod: eu-west-1:10%, us-west-2:10%, us-east-1:10%.
Oli: Observability: p95 eu-west jumped to 520ms at 16:06, error delta +0.2%. Recommend hold at 10% and run diag.
Maya: HOLD manual. Do NOT progress to 30%. Pin eu-west to stable variant for safety. Command:```deployctl pin --region eu-west-1 --model stable-1.9 --reason "canary p95 spike"```
deploy-bot: Pin applied: eu-west-1 pinned to stable-1.9. Rollout rr-20260320-47 paused at 10%.
Jordan: Running flamegraphs and flushing caches on the canaries now.
Priya: found a misconfigured tokenization flag on v2.3 hosts in eu-west (split == false). Preparing patch. ETA ~10m.
Maya: If patch fixes, resume to 25% after a 15m hold and re-evaluate. Rollback plan if things don't improve: full revert to stable-1.9 globally.
Chris: Should we draft a customer-facing note now? I'd keep it internal unless we have visible user impact.
Maya: Agreed, internal for now.
Priya: Patch rolled to canaries at 16:18, metrics trending down: eu-west p95 -> 480ms, error delta back to baseline.
Oli: +1 looks stable. Recommend moving to 25% but keep eu-west pinned for another 20m.
Maya: GO to 25% for non-eu regions, keep eu-west pinned. @deploy-bot proceed.
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout: non-eu regions -> 25%. eu-west remains pinned. New distribution: us-east-1:25%, us-west-2:25%, eu-west-1:pinned->stable-1.9.
Jordan: Monitoring traces. No new OOMs, cache miss ratio normal.
Maya: Hold at 25% for 20m then reassess for 60% decision. Call back in 20.
-- 20m later --
Priya: After 20m, metrics stable. global p95 430ms, error delta ~0%. eu-west still pinned.
Maya: Decision: proceed to 60% but keep canary autoscaling ramped (+1 replica margin). Keep eu-west pinned until 60% completes.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 60% with eu-west pinned.
Oli: Observability: after the 60% shift there is a memory pressure spike in us-west, one host evicted and auto-replaced.
Maya: STOP. Rollback to previous stable distribution (25%) immediately for safety. Initiate rollback to stable-1.9 globally.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: reverting rr-20260320-47. Target model -> stable-1.9 across all regions.
Jordan: Rollback finished in ~6m. Confirming traffic now back to stable-1.9 100%.
Maya: Postmortem to follow. Immediate action items: 1) add tokenization flag sanity check to preflight, 2) add explicit eu-west hold step in rollout playbook, 3) tighten p95 alert threshold to 450ms for canaries.
Chris: I'll open the PR for playbook edits and a draft release note for internal review.
Priya: Filing incident and tagging affected canaries + logs.
Maya: Thanks team. Good catch on the tokenization flag. Ending thread. :thumbsup:
